gen-gf-phudu-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter reads crisp and unclogged, even where the counters shrink small. Phudu's loud, ballpoint-plain display letters sit above it, and TASA Orbiter keeps the text quiet underneath them.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tomorrow: Bold, distinctive Phudu holds the heading with a level beat and no flicks of weight. And Tomorrow, with its cupped, open bowls, keeps the sans-serif text running smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Distinctive and loud, Phudu takes the top line. Tsukimi Rounded follows in round, parenthesis-like forms whose parallel edges keep a long stretch of sans text soft and easy going.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tuffy: Loud, plain, and pen-drawn: that's Phudu up top. Tuffy follows in pencil-sketched sans letters with a widely parted s, giving the heading's heft somewhere quieter to land.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-urbanist: Contemporary Urbanist carries the text with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut. But Phudu is the one built to shout, bold and distinctive, while the plain sans simply keeps talking.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-albert-sans: Blocky, bold, a bit playful: that's Pixelify Sans on top. And Albert Sans keeps its apertures open at tiny sizes, so paragraphs of text run on without any strain.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-alef: Pixelify Sans draws everything in a steady line with no thin strokes to vanish in glare. And Alef, a modern plain sans with open-ended curves, carries the text underneath it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads contemporary and modern, its brush ends lifting away before each curve can close. Pixelify Sans shouts over it in blunt, signage-plain lines.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-bpmf-huninn: Pixelify Sans leads with a bold, unvarying line and a c as open as a bent paperclip. But Bpmf Huninn, with its single-weight outline feel and wide channels into every bowl, matches that plainness.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-st: Chunky, bold, and unmistakably pixel-built, Pixelify Sans carries the heading in strokes with no thick or thin at all. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std adds a gentle swell.
